name: "WE NEED TO TALK"
title: "Hey. We need to talk." Why your heart races 😰 #shorts
description:
"Hey. We need to talk." No context, and your heart is already racing. In one study, people were more stressed when they couldn't predict a small electric shock than when they knew it was coming. Uncertainty itself is stressful, so your brain fills the gap with the worst version. Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: THE WAVE
title: Waved back at someone who wasn't waving at you? 👋 #shorts
description:
You wave back… and they were waving at the person behind you. Psychologists call it the spotlight effect: we think everyone saw it, but most people barely noticed. 👋 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: THE TYPO
title: Why you only see the typo AFTER you hit send 🤦 #shorts
description:
You read it five times. Perfect. Send. Typo. When you check your own words, your brain already knows what you meant, so it reads what it expects instead of what's actually there. 🤦 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: "SEEN"
title: "Seen." No reply. Why you can't stop checking 📱 #shorts
description:
"Seen." No reply. Unfinished things tend to stick in the mind: psychologists call it the Zeigarnik effect. A message with no reply is an open loop, and that's why you keep checking. 📱 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: "LOVE YOU, BYE"
title: Said "love you, bye" to your boss? There's a name for it 😳 #shorts
description:
Your boss ends the call and you say "Okay, love you, bye." Psychologists call it an action slip: some phrases run on autopilot, and when you're not paying attention the autopilot grabs the wheel. Not a secret feeling, just a habit in the wrong place. 😳 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: THE NAME
title: Why you forget their name 2 seconds after hearing it 🤯 #shorts
description:
"Hi, I'm Sarah." Two seconds later: gone. It's called the next-in-line effect: while you wait for your turn to speak, your brain is busy planning what to say, so the words right before it barely get stored. 🤯 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: THE LAUGH
title: Ever laughed at something that wasn't a joke? 😬 #shorts
description:
Everyone laughs, you laugh too… and it wasn't a joke. Laughter is mostly social: one researcher found people were about thirty times more likely to laugh with others around than when alone. 😬 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: THE DOORWAY
title: Why you forget why you walked into a room 🚪 #shorts
description:
You walk into the kitchen and have no idea why. Researchers found that walking through a doorway can make people forget more than staying in the same room: a doorway works like an event boundary. 🚪 Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: YOUR VOICE
title: Why your recorded voice sounds so weird 🎙️ #shorts
description:
That is not what you sound like… but it is. When you talk, you hear yourself through the air AND through the bones of your skull, which makes your voice sound deeper to you. A recording only catches the air. 🎙️ Send this to a friend who needs it.

name: THE ORDER
title: Practiced your order 10 times and still messed it up? ☕ #shorts
description:
You rehearse your order ten times, then: "Can I get a… large… small… thing?" Psychologists call it choking under pressure: watching yourself too closely can break something you normally do on autopilot. ☕ Send this to a friend who needs it.
